records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield

decisions.rationale: Mia explicitly said they're still deciding and asked for another week (email:0cdcc3e2), which runs past the 8 days remaining. No project, no invite, and an unresolved SSO question escalated internally (tick_ca17ff434dc1, slack:4557f986) block momentum; Pro plan is the only positive signal.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for being straight with me — totally fair to take another week to decide if Wrenfield is right for your team. I'll keep things low-touch until then.

On your open SSO ticket: support still has it, and for context, SSO is available on the Team plan. Your IT team is welcome to send questions through that thread.

If it would help your evaluation, I'm happy to walk you through creating a first project on a 20-minute call this week — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so it's the quickest way to see the fit.

Best,
Priya
